name: EnPro Industries
outlook:
What EnPro Industries says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPSEnpro is raising guidance for full-year 2026 and now expects revenue to be in the range of $1.33 billion to $1.34 billion, or a 16% to 17% increase year over year, adjusted EBITDA* in the range of $340 million to $345 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share* in the range of $9.70 to $9.95.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
